content.short: Verse is a full-featured decentralized exchange built on bitcoin.com.
content.description: Verse DEX opens permissionless, non-custodial trading to all, with a special focus on DeFi newcomers. Built to be a DEX anyone can use, Verse DEX offers a straightforward, non-intimidating experience for first-time users. Integrated into a popular wallet with millions of users, Verse DEX provides an easy entry point to trading. It currently runs on Ethereum and SmartBCH and is continually expanding to other low-fee, fast blockchains.
